seo.title: Privacy Notice | HeartLink
seo.description: How HeartLink collects, uses, protects and responds to requests about private matchmaking and enquiry information.

hero.title: Your details stay private.
hero.description: This notice explains what we collect, why we use it, when we share it and how to ask for access, correction, deletion or withdrawal of consent.

content.title: The HeartLink privacy notice
content.lead: Privacy is not an add-on. It is the operating standard for every enquiry, review and introduction.
content.intro: HeartLink acts as the data fiduciary for information submitted through this website or shared with our team for private matchmaking. This notice applies to applicants, family representatives, partners and general enquirers.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: Depending on your enquiry, we may collect contact details; identity, age bracket and location; education and professional background; family information; preferences, values and relationship context; social or professional profile links; service interest; messages, consent records and basic technical submission data.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: We use information to review and verify enquiries, assess whether HeartLink can help, maintain the Private Registry, identify potentially relevant introductions, communicate with authorised representatives, provide agreed matchmaking or guidance services, protect clients and our systems, and meet legal or record-keeping obligations.

sections.title: How information is shared
sections.body: Profiles are not public, browsable or searchable. Within HeartLink, access is limited to people who need the information for review or service delivery. Identifying information is shared with a prospective introduction only after approval and genuine mutual interest. We may also use confidential service providers for secure storage, email delivery and website operations, or disclose information when required by law. We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.body: We retain information only for as long as it remains relevant to the Private Registry, an active engagement, a legitimate follow-up need or a legal requirement. We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards, but no digital system can be guaranteed completely secure.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
sections.body: You may ask what personal data we hold about you, request correction or deletion, withdraw consent, or raise a privacy concern. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing already completed and may limit our ability to continue an enquiry or service. We may need to verify identity or authority before acting on a request.

sections.title: Information about another person
sections.body: If you enquire for a son, daughter, relative or another individual, you must be authorised to share their information and should ensure they understand how HeartLink will use it. The service is intended for adults; please do not submit information about a minor.

sections.title: Contact the privacy desk
sections.body: For access, correction, deletion, consent withdrawal or a complaint, email privacy@heartlink.in. We may update this notice as our services or legal obligations change; the date above shows the latest revision.
